sloka: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य चुकोप सौमित्रिरमित्रहन्ता।अमृष्यमाणश्च समुत्पपात जग्राह चापं च ततः स्मयित्वा ।। ६.७१.४६ ।।
transliteration: tattasya vākyaṁ bruvato niśamya cukopa saumitriramitrahantā।amṛṣyamāṇaśca samutpapāta jagrāha cāpaṁ ca tataḥ smayitvā ।। 6.71.46 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Atikaya, Saumithri the destroyer of enemies, became angry, not enduring and not able to tolerate went towards him taking a sword.
